claims.text: The Instrument of Dissolution, signed TUPOU VI and done at Nuku'alofa on 24 August 2017, states that the King, having considered advice from the Lord Speaker and having regard to Clauses 38 and 77(2), dissolves the Legislative Assembly 'with effect from Thursday 24 August 2017 at 1700 hours', with elections to be held no later than 16 November 2017. The instrument does not mention the Prime Minister.
claims.locator: Gazette Supplement Extraordinary No. 14, 25 August 2017, pp. 55-56
claims.uncertainty: Dissolves the Assembly. It is not a dismissal of the Prime Minister and provides no caretaker instrument.
